name: Agenvas
tagline: Self-hosted AI creation canvas for text, images, video and audio
description: Agenvas is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI creation canvas for individual creators. It brings text, images, video, audio and agents into one infinite canvas, where cards can be connected and reused across a creative workflow. Users configure their own model endpoints and media capabilities, including OpenAI-compatible language models and supported image, video and audio adapters. The app supports per-card generation, version history, reusable project assets and prompt templates. Agent-generated media proposals require approval before running. Agenvas can be deployed with Docker Compose. The software is open source; hosting and third-party model usage may incur separate costs.
